method: Three sequential fresh native boots in one Node process. Each named sample uses the generic Wasm BF executor, 2e14 BF-instruction / 3e10 block limit, raw source input and drained native output. Native boot includes Thread compilation; artifact load is separate and performed once. No other project test or browser command intentionally runs during these samples. This is an observed local process benchmark, not a browser/frame-rate or server claim.
